title: Dare to Be Square
description: Paintings by Marc Bernier and sculpture by Tadashi Hashimoto, two artists who use the square and the cube as a vehicle for creation.

Exhibition card for Dare to Be Square, Holland Tunnel Newburgh, 2022

about: Dare to Be Square brings together paintings by Marc Bernier and sculpture by Tadashi Hashimoto. Both artists use the square and the cube as a vehicle for creation in the works exhibited. They delight in the potential of the square and its capacity to generate possibilities within a recognized universal language.

program.text: Artist talk and closing reception: Marc Bernier and Tadashi Hashimoto on their work, inspiration, process and the dialogue between their work
